title: Robinin decreases myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury via Nrf2 anti-oxidative effects mediated by Akt/GSK3beta/Fyn in hypercholesterolemic rats.
authors: Shen, XiBao; Liu, AiJun; Li, LiuGen; Zhu, JianFang; Yuan, JianHai; Wu, Liming; Zhang, Xuehong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Robinin在心肌缺血再灌注损伤中的抗氧化作用，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Robinin (RB) is an accepted antioxidant herbal product with known cardio-protective activity. To explore the anti-oxidative potential of RB in treating myocardial ischemia or reperfusion (MI/RI) damage in rats after inducing hypercholesterolemia (HC). HC was induced by administering cholesterol (2%) to rats for eight weeks. The rats were given RB (50 mg/kg bw) for the last two weeks. The rats were arbitrarily divided into four groups: (Group I) normal control, (Group II) hypercholesterolemic (HC) alone, (Group III) HC + RB (50 mg/kg body weight), and (Group IV) RB alone (50 mg/kg body weight). LV-developed pressure (LVDP), and left ventricular end-diastolic pressure (LVEDP) were recorded during the perfusion process. Histopathology staining was used to analyze liver and kidney damage in heart tissue (H&E, MT, and PAS stains), and in silico techniques, such as molecular docking and MD simulation, were employed. Results revealed that RB administration reduced MI/RI in HC rats due to Akt/GSK3beta/Fyn-as facilitated Nrf2 anti-oxidative function. Administering RB to HC rats resulted in increased expression of Akt, whereas it reduced the Fyn and GSK3beta levels, which activated Nrf2 activity. When RB is administered to HC rats. Glide (a Schrodinger module) was used to dock RB with NQO1, Nrf-2, HO-1, GSK-3beta, and Akt to select the best interacting drug action on inflammatory markers for the therapeutic action of RB and followed OH-1 and Nrf2 MD simulation study were carried out. These results highlight how Nrf2 antioxidative effects are mediated by Akt/GSK3beta/Fyn are enhanced by RB, protecting the HC heart from MI/RI.
abstract_zh: Robinin (RB) 是一种公认的具有心脏保护活性的抗氧化草药产品。为探讨RB在诱导高胆固醇血症（HC）后大鼠心肌缺血或再灌注（MI/RI）损伤中的抗氧化潜力，通过给予大鼠胆固醇（2%）八周以诱导HC。最后两周给予大鼠RB（50 mg/kg体重）。将大鼠任意分为四组：（I组）正常对照，（II组）单独高胆固醇血症（HC），（III组）HC + RB（50 mg/kg体重），（IV组）单独RB（50 mg/kg体重）。在灌注过程中记录左心室发展压（LVDP）和左心室舒张末期压（LVEDP）。使用组织病理学染色分析心脏组织中的肝脏和肾脏损伤（H&E、MT和PAS染色），并采用分子对接和MD模拟等计算机模拟技术。结果显示，RB给药通过Akt/GSK3beta/Fyn介导的Nrf2抗氧化功能，减轻了HC大鼠的MI/RI损伤。对HC大鼠给予RB导致Akt表达增加，同时降低Fyn和GSK3beta水平，从而激活Nrf2活性。当RB给予HC大鼠时，使用Glide（一种Schrodinger模块）将RB与NQO1、Nrf-2、HO-1、GSK-3beta和Akt进行对接，以选择对炎症标志物最佳相互作用的药物作用，用于RB的治疗作用，随后进行了OH-1和Nrf2的MD模拟研究。这些结果强调了RB如何通过增强Akt/GSK3beta/Fyn介导的Nrf2抗氧化效应，保护HC心脏免受MI/RI损伤。
